line.a_ogon.text: And if I have no tape, I'll measure everything with my tail!

line.a_szybko.text: I'll help! Quick, quick, I'll pile the blocks any old way!

line.a_spadla.text: Oh no! The big block wouldn't stay on the small one and it fell.

line.a_po_kolei.text: A tower only stands when the blocks are put in order.

line.a_jak.text: In order? How do you mean?

line.a_od_najwiekszego.text: At the bottom the biggest block, on it a smaller one, then a smaller one still, and at the top the smallest. Drag the blocks onto the line on the grass and build the tower.

line.a_dlaczego.text: It stands because the blocks are in order: from the biggest to the smallest.

line.b_schodki.text: Now let's make steps down to the water, out of stones.

line.b_od_najnizszego.text: Steps go in order: first the lowest stone, then a higher one, and last the highest. Start where the arrow is.

line.zla_kolejnosc.text: That's not its place. Look at what's next to it, and put them in order.

line.b_schodki_ok.text: Lovely steps! The lowest, higher, the highest.

line.p_start.text: Let's practise putting things in order! I have five games.

line.p_kubki.text: Put the cups in order: from the smallest to the biggest. Start at the arrow.

line.p_marchewki.text: And now the carrots the other way: from the biggest to the smallest. Start at the arrow.

line.p_luka.text: The apples grow in order, but one is missing. Which apple fits the gap? Point to it.

line.p_luka_nie.text: That apple is too big or too small. We need one bigger than the one before the gap, and smaller than the one after it.

line.p_luka_ok.text: Yes! Now the apples grow in order.

line.p_ktory_rzad.text: In which row are the leaves in order? Point to that row.

line.p_ktory_rzad_nie.text: In this row the leaves are mixed up. Look at the other row.

line.p_ktory_rzad_ok.text: Yes! Here the leaves grow in order.

line.p_wieza.text: Last, build a tower on the line: the biggest block at the bottom.

line.p_wieza_ok.text: It stands! What a builder you are!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping me build! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the lantern from Beaver's tower. We got it when we were getting the concert ready and putting everything in order.

line.a_koncert.text: Hello! I'm Beaver, the builder. Tonight there's a big concert in the forest glade! I must get everything ready.

line.a_latarnia.text: First I'll build a tower for a lantern, so the guests can find the way in the dark.

line.a_latarenka.text: The lantern shines at the very top! Now everyone will find the concert.

line.b_mapa.text: Look what I have: an old map of the way to the glade!

line.b_mapa_gdzie.text: The dotted path goes across the brook. Show on the map where the path crosses the brook.

line.b_mapa_nie.text: There's no water here. Look for the place where the dots of the path meet the blue brook.

line.b_mapa_tu.text: Yes, right here! This is where we'll make a way across the brook.

line.b_sowa.text: I'm glad you're here! My owlets can't fly yet, and they so want to sing at the concert. How will they cross the water?

line.b_przeszly.text: Hop, hop, hop! They're all across. Thank you!

line.c_polana.text: We're at the glade! How lovely, the lanterns are shining already.

line.c_proba.text: Let's rehearse the choir. The owlets stand in a row in order: from the smallest to the biggest.

line.c_ustaw.text: Drag the owlets to their places. The smallest stands by the arrow.

line.c_spiewaja.text: How lovely they sing when they stand in order!

line.c_psikus.text: Hee hee! I'll swap two owlets around.

line.c_falsz.text: Oh dear, the choir sounds wrong! Which owlet is not in its place? Point to it.

line.c_falsz_nie.text: That owlet is in the right place. Look where the row stops growing.

line.c_znowu.text: In order again, and it sounds lovely again!

line.c_przepraszam.text: Sorry, owlets! I won't do it again.

line.c_instrument.text: There's still time before the evening. Let's go home, I'll get my instrument ready!

line.d_szklanki.text: Here is my instrument: glasses of water! Tap each one and listen.

line.d_rozne.text: Each sounds different! The one with lots of water sounds low, the one with a little sounds high.

line.d_uloz.text: Put the glasses in order: from the one with the most water to the one with the least. Start by the arrow.

line.d_gama.text: Can you hear it? The notes go up, like steps!

line.d_zagraj.text: Now you play: tap the glasses in order, from the first to the last.

line.d_zagraj_nie.text: Not that one yet. Tap the next one in order.

line.d_brawo.text: Bravo, musician! Tonight we'll play it together at the concert.

line.d_rodzice_szklanki.text: With your parents, pour water into a few glasses, put them in order and listen to them play.
